checkpoints.description: A 3D node-and-edge knowledge graph rendered in Qualia, dark theme, viewed in a browser viewport. ARTISTIC: painterly - warm bloom, saturated colour grade, smoothly curved (catmull-rom) edges rather than straight segments, and visible chromatic aberration / colour fringing at high-contrast borders.
